source.description: Classify one structured event using the following public policy. Critical means risk TRUE, or action change in context internal; critical cases require deny. Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain. Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90. Trusted means role analyst or auditor, except for action change; a trusted approve prefers review at priority 80. Action delete in context internal prefers deny at priority 70. Role auditor or context sandbox prefers allow at priority 40. Trusted cases forbid allow. All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1. Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
requirements: Critical means risk TRUE, or action change in context internal; critical cases require deny.
Unknown external: risk UNKNOWN in context internal returns uncertain.
Unknown risk otherwise prefers allow at priority 90.
Trusted means role analyst or auditor, except for action change; a trusted approve prefers review at priority 80.
Action delete in context internal prefers deny at priority 70.
Role auditor or context sandbox prefers allow at priority 40.
All other declared roles prefer review at priority 1.
Required labels override preferences. Abstention or conflicting required labels returns uncertain. Forbidden labels are removed; the remaining highest-priority preference wins.
forbidden_shortcuts: Use every field named by a relevant rule.

repairs.original_source:
predicate Critical(event):
    (event.risk == TRUE) or ((event.action == change) and (event.context == internal))

predicate Trusted(event):
    ((event.role == analyst) or (event.role == auditor)) and (event.action != change)

predicate UnknownExternal(event):
    (event.risk == UNKNOWN) and (event.context == internal)

rule CriticalCase:
    when Critical(event)
    then require label = deny

rule UnknownExternalCase:
    when UnknownExternal(event)
    then abstain

rule UnknownRisk:
    when event.risk == UNKNOWN
    then prefer label = allow priority 90

rule TrustedApprove:
    when (Trusted(event)) and (event.action == approve)
    then prefer label = review priority 80, forbid label = allow

rule DeleteInternal:
    when (event.action == delete) and (event.context == internal)
    then prefer label = deny priority 70

rule AuditorOrSandbox:
    when (event.role == auditor) or (event.context == sandbox)
    then prefer label = allow priority 40

rule OtherRoles:
    when ((event.role != analyst) and (event.role != auditor)) and (event.role != guest)
    then prefer label = review priority 1

deployment_description: Classify one structured event using the supplied compiled instructions. The allowed outputs are review, deny, allow, uncertain. These names are arbitrary symbols, so do not infer their meaning. Copy the output stated by the matching compiled instruction.
